name: Bench Press
description: The fundamental exercise for upper body strength, focused on developing the pectorals and triceps. Ensure you maintain a slight arch in your back and keep your feet firmly on the ground.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Targets the upper chest (clavicular pectoral). Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree angle and control the weight on the descent.

name: Cable Crossovers
description: Excellent isolation movement for finishing the workout, providing constant tension throughout the pectorals' full range of motion.

name: Deadlift
description: An essential compound exercise for the entire posterior chain. Keep the bar close to your shins and lift by pushing the floor away with your legs.

name: Pull-ups
description: The most effective method to build back width (latissimus dorsi) using only body weight.

name: Barbell Rows
description: Basic exercise for back depth and density. Keep your back straight at a 45-90 degree angle to the ground.

name: Squats
description: The king of leg exercises. Develops muscle mass in the quadriceps and glutes, and improves core stability.

name: Leg Press
description: A safe alternative to squats that allows for overloading the legs without stressing the lower back.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
description: Focus on pushing the hips back (hip hinge) to stretch and intensely work the hamstrings.

name: Overhead Press
description: The best exercise for front deltoid strength and shoulder mass development. Keep your core tight.

name: Lateral Raises
description: Isolates the medial deltoids. Use light weights and control the descent to avoid swinging.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: The most effective mass builder for biceps. Keep your elbows fixed close to your body during the curl.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Optimally isolates the short and long heads of the triceps. Press toward the floor while keeping your chest up and shoulders down.

name: Cable Crunches
description: Allows for abdominal training with added weight. Think about bringing your chest toward your pelvis, rounding your spine.

name: Plank
description: Fundamental isometric exercise for the endurance of the transverse abdominal wall and spinal stabilization.

name: Chest Press Machine
description: Isolation exercise that targets the inner chest fibers. Squeeze at the peak contraction and control the eccentric.

name: Pec Deck / Butterfly
description: Similar to bench press but allows a greater range of motion and independent arm movement for balanced development.

name: Flat Dumbbell Press
description: Targets the lower chest (sternal head). Set the bench at a slight decline and press the dumbbells upward.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
description: Stretching isolation movement for the chest. Keep a slight bend in the elbows and control the descent.

name: Flat Dumbbell Flyes
description: Targets the upper chest with a fly motion on an incline bench. Focus on the stretch at the bottom.

name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
description: Barbell press on an incline bench targeting the upper pectorals. Use a 30-45 degree angle for best results.

name: Incline Bench Press
description: Barbell press on a decline bench emphasizing the lower chest fibers. Use a spotter for safety.

name: Decline Bench Press
description: Machine-based rowing movement for mid-back thickness. Keep chest pressed against the pad and squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Seated Machine Row
description: Machine-assisted version of pull-ups. Great for building up to bodyweight pull-ups by gradually reducing assistance.

name: Assisted Pull-ups
description: Powerful compound movement for back thickness. Keep your torso at 45 degrees and pull the weight into your lower chest.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Wide grip pulldown targeting the lats for width. Pull the bar to your upper chest while keeping your torso upright.

name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
description: Close grip variation emphasizing the lower lats and biceps. Use a V-bar or close grip handle.

name: Lat Pulldown (Close Grip)
description: Underhand grip pulldown that increases bicep involvement and targets the lower lats effectively.

name: Lat Pulldown (Reverse Grip)
description: Seated row using a cable machine. Maintain a neutral spine and squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of each rep.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Isolation exercise for the lats. Keep arms straight and pull the bar down in an arc toward your thighs.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pullover
description: Stretching movement that targets both the lats and chest. Lie across a bench and lower the dumbbell behind your head.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Bilateral rowing with dumbbells. Hinge at the hips and row both dumbbells toward your waist simultaneously.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Isolation exercise for the quadriceps. Extend the legs fully and squeeze at the top, then lower with control.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
description: Targets the hamstrings in a seated position. Control the weight on both the concentric and eccentric portions.

name: Leg Extensions
description: Prone hamstring curl that effectively isolates the hamstrings. Avoid lifting your hips off the pad.

name: Seated Leg Curls
description: Targets the outer (abductor) or inner (adductor) thigh muscles depending on the setting.

name: Lying Leg Curls
description: Standing or seated calf raises on a machine. Full range of motion with a pause at the top contraction.

name: Hip Abductor / Adductor Machine
description: Glute isolation exercise using a cable machine. Attach an ankle strap and kick your leg straight back.

name: Machine Calf Raises
description: Targets the outer glutes and hip abductors. Stand sideways to the machine and raise your leg laterally.

name: Cable Kickbacks
description: Single-leg hamstring curl using a cable. Attach an ankle strap and curl your heel toward your glute.

name: Cable Lateral Leg Raises
description: Hold a dumbbell at chest height and squash. Great for learning proper squat form and depth.

name: Standing Cable Leg Curls
description: Step forward or walk while lunging for unilateral leg development. Keep your torso upright throughout.

name: Goblet Squats
description: Romanian deadlift variation with dumbbells. Focus on the hip hinge while keeping the weights close to your legs.

name: Lunges
description: Step onto a box or bench holding dumbbells. Focuses on single-leg strength and glute activation.

name: Dumbbell RDL
description: Rear foot elevated split squat. Excellent for unilateral leg strength and balance. Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.

name: Step-ups
description: Barbell squat with the bar resting on the front deltoids. Emphasizes the quads more than back squats.

name: Bulgarian Split Squats
description: The best exercise for glute activation and development. Rest upper back on a bench and drive hips upward with a barbell on your lap.

name: Front Squats
description: Walking or stationary lunges with a barbell on your back. Challenges balance and builds leg endurance.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Standing calf raises with a barbell on your back. Rise onto your toes and squeeze at the top.

name: Barbell Lunges
description: Machine-based overhead pressing for the deltoids. Provides a fixed path of motion for safe pressing.

name: Barbell Calf Raises
description: Targets the posterior deltoid by performing reverse flyes on the pec deck machine. Squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
description: Lateral raise performed on a machine. Provides consistent resistance throughout the range of motion.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
description: Single-arm lateral raises with a cable. Stand sideways and raise the handle to shoulder height with control.

name: Machine Lateral Raises
description: Essential exercise for rear deltoid and rotator cuff health. Pull the rope attachment toward your face, externally rotating at the top.

name: Cable Lateral Raises
description: Front deltoid isolation using a cable. Raise the handle in front of you to shoulder height with a straight arm.

name: Face Pulls
description: Seated or standing overhead press with dumbbells. Allows a more natural path of motion than barbell pressing.

name: Cable Front Raises
description: Isolation exercise for the front deltoids. Raise dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, alternating or together.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Bent-over fly movement targeting the posterior deltoid. Maintain a slight bend in the elbows throughout.

name: Dumbbell Front Raises
description: Compound movement for delts and traps. Pull the bar up along your body to chin level, leading with elbows.

name: Rear Delt Flyes
description: Machine-based preacher curl that isolates the biceps by eliminating momentum. Focus on the eccentric phase.

name: Upright Row
description: Seated biceps curl machine. Provides a fixed range of motion for consistent biceps isolation.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
description: A machine-based pressing movement that isolates the chest. Great for beginners or finishing sets safely without a spotter.

name: Biceps Curl Machine
description: Unilateral rowing movement for balanced back development. Support yourself on a bench and pull the weight to your hip.

name: Cable Bicep Curl
description: Standing curls using a straight or EZ bar attachment on a cable. Constant tension throughout the entire rep.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
description: Hammer curl variation using a rope cable attachment. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis along with biceps.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curls
description: Classic alternating bicep curls with dumbbells. Supinate your wrist as you curl for full bicep contraction.

name: Hammer Curls
description: Neutral grip curls that target the brachialis and forearms in addition to the biceps. Keep palms facing each other.

name: Concentration Curls
description: Seated single-arm curl with your elbow braced against your inner thigh. Maximum isolation for the bicep peak.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
description: Curls performed on an incline bench for a deeper stretch on the long head of the biceps. Do not swing the weight.

name: EZ Bar Curls
description: Bicep curls with an EZ curl bar. The angled grip reduces wrist strain while effectively targeting the biceps.

name: EZ Bar Preacher Curls
description: Preacher curls using an EZ bar on a preacher bench. Eliminates momentum for strict bicep isolation.

name: Triceps Extension Machine
description: Seated machine triceps extension. Provides a guided range of motion for safe and effective triceps isolation.

name: Assisted Dips
description: Machine-assisted dips to build triceps and chest strength. Gradually reduce assistance as you get stronger.

name: Triceps Pushdowns
description: Cable pushdowns using a bar or rope attachment. Keep elbows pinned to your sides and extend fully at the bottom.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: Face away from the cable machine and extend overhead. Targets the long head of the triceps effectively.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: Single or double-arm overhead extension with dumbbells. Lower the weight behind your head and extend fully.

name: Triceps Kickbacks
description: Bent-over kickback movement. Extend the dumbbell behind you while keeping the upper arm stationary.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrushers
description: Lying triceps extension with dumbbells. Lower the weights to the sides of your forehead and press back up.

name: EZ Bar Skullcrushers
description: Classic triceps exercise lying on a bench. Lower the EZ bar toward your forehead, then extend fully.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Bench press with hands closer together to shift emphasis from chest to triceps. Keep elbows tucked.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
description: Seated abdominal crunch machine with adjustable resistance. Focus on contracting your abs, not pulling with arms.

name: Torso Rotation Machine
description: Seated machine for rotational core work. Rotate your torso against resistance to target the obliques.

name: Cable Woodchoppers
description: Diagonal chopping motion using a cable. Rotate through your core while keeping arms relatively straight.

name: Dumbbell Side Bends
description: Lateral flexion of the trunk holding a dumbbell on one side. Controlled movement to target the obliques.

name: Russian Twists
description: Seated twisting movement holding a dumbbell. Lean back slightly and rotate side to side with control.

name: Barbell Rollouts
description: Anti-extension exercise using a loaded barbell. Roll forward slowly and pull back using your abs. Extremely challenging.

name: Landmine Twists
description: Rotational exercise using one end of a barbell anchored in a corner. Rotate the bar from side to side with straight arms.

name: Shoulder Shrugs
description: The Back Extension is a focused isolation exercise designed to strengthen the erector spinae muscles that run along the spine.

name: Back Extensions
description: The Shoulder Shrug is a fundamental isolation exercise designed to build strength and mass in the upper trapezius.
